defaults.composition: One wide view in which all of these are clearly visible and not blocking each other: a fireplace with a real burning wood fire, a decorated Christmas tree with warm fairy lights, a large window with big snowflakes clearly falling outside against the night sky, and in the foreground a low table with a cup of hot coffee giving off a clearly visible thin wisp of white steam rising against a darker background and a small plate of Christmas food
defaults.motion_elements: the burning fire, the tree lights, the steam from the cup and the falling snow outside the window

shots.subject: A log cabin living room with a tall stone fireplace, a red plaid sofa, a tall pine tree with warm white lights and red baubles, and a big window onto snowy pines; on the table a mug of coffee and gingerbread cookies

motion_where.candles: on the mantel, in the lanterns and in the glass holder on the table
